contexts.text: Those who have been delighted with more pleasures... are delighted to stay long in privies, perceiving there what is most delightful...
Those with whom evils have predominated... are conveyed... into the intestines... to the colon and rectum, and are thence voided into the privy; that is, into Hell.

A certain person was translated to (the Hells of the cruel adulterers). He said that nothing but privies appear there. Those there spoke to him, and led him to various privies... DMin 4765, Explained.

To be cast out into the privy () = into Hell; for the belly corresponds to the way towards Hell; and the privy corresponds to Hell; and in the Word Hell is called a privy. Explained. AE 580:2. AE 622:5.
Around those in falsities from evil appear marshes, privies, etc.

Those who have passed their lives in mere pleasures, and have lived delicately, and have indulged the palate and the belly, loving these things as the highest good of life, in the other life love excrementitious things and privies, which are then a source of delectation to them... SE 3211.
I have seen those in power, who in the world have dominated from the love of self, rejected among the most vile, and some among those who are in privies there.
Such (as interior witches) are those who dwell in privies.
Certain in Hell also desired to glorify (the Lord), as I heard from... those who are in privies.
(The revengeful) who do not suffer themselves to be mastered in any other way, are sent into a great privy, and immersed...
Such Genii and Spirits dwell in the sepulchres, privies, and marshes which are in the natural world, although they do not know it.

Those who have been addicted to variety, and have thereby extinguished the Conjugial, and who are at the same time voluptuous, are in a province beneath the intestines, where there are privies everywhere, and a foul stink.
